title: Equity Brief — 05 Oct 2026
intro: Global equities display transatlantic divergence as US markets extend gains in a RISK ON environment with VIX at 16.29, while European indices struggle under profit-taking pressure. Tech-driven momentum propels US indices higher with Nasdaq leading at +1.19%, contrasting sharply with European weakness led by CAC 40 down 2.75% weekly.

sections.heading: 🌍 INDEX RANKING
sections.content:
Nikkei 225 69,947 +2.40% — Explosive rally continues on weak yen and semiconductor strength
Nasdaq 27,191 +1.19% — Mega-cap tech buying accelerates as AI optimism resurges
Russell 2000 2,832.90 +0.94% — Small-caps catch bid on dovish Fed expectations
S&P 500 5,769.64 +0.74% — Broad-based advance maintains bullish structure
IBEX 35 19,193 +0.56% — Only European gainer on banking sector resilience
CAC 40 7,815 -1.05% — Worst performer, luxury goods weigh heavily
🇺🇸 US MARKET
S&P 500 at 5,769.64 holds above 5,750 support with bias to test 5,800 resistance; catalyst is sustained tech sector rotation and earnings optimism building ahead of Q3 season.
Nasdaq 27,191 breaks above 27,000 psychological level with momentum accelerating; AI infrastructure spending narratives drive semiconductor and cloud names higher.
Dow Jones 51,177 lags peers but holds 51,000; industrial and financial sector consolidation limits upside despite stable macro backdrop.
🇪🇺 EUROPE
DAX 25,213 -0.07% trades flat as German manufacturing data disappoints and energy concerns resurface.
FTSE 100 10,485 +0.22% shows relative strength on defensive positioning and sterling weakness supporting exporters.
CAC 40 7,815 -1.05% extends weekly decline to -2.75% as LVMH and luxury sector face China demand headwinds.
💻 TECH FOCUS
Tesla 370.59 +4.65% surges on production beat rumors and autonomous driving regulatory optimism building into Robotaxi event.
Nvidia 233.95 +1.34% consolidates recent gains as Blackwell chip demand visibility remains robust with hyperscaler capex commitments intact.

sections.heading: 🎯 TRADE IDEAS
sections.content:
LONG: Nasdaq 27,191 — Tech momentum continuation, entry 27,150, SL 26,900, TP 27,600
LONG: Tesla 370.59 — Event-driven catalyst into October, entry 368.00, SL 355.00, TP 395.00
SHORT/AVOID: CAC 40 7,815 — Luxury sector China exposure and technical breakdown below 7,850 support suggest further downside to 7,650
